subject: Revised TGP2 review: define shape/format domains and compiler-unknown view fields
body: Concrete TGP2 manifest review: header128 +64-byte records, checked offsets/count/length and direct table1/2 mapping now address the original draft mismatch. Before compiler implementation ACK, define enum domains for shape dimension/result numericclass and storage_format/view_format (SPIR-V ImageFormat? VkFormat? Metal?). Compiler receives SPIR-V+specialization only and CANNOT infer bound sampled-image view_format/view_level/view_layer; those must have documented unspecified sentinels and be supplied/validated by Rust/runtime sidecar, or compiler API must explicitly receive agreed extra facts. Do not fabricate0 as a real format/level equality. Parser also currently permits same nativebinding reused as buffer(table0)+texture/sampler(other table), and image+sampler. Reject cross-kind collisions except an explicitly allowed combined sampled texture+sampler pair at sameN; reject nonzero irrelevant image/shape fields on buffers, dummy and standalone samplers unless meaningful per-use contract defines them. Storage/read/query sampled access classes and atomic bits need exact definitions for lowering. Please post concrete definitions to board now so lowering can ACK/implement without guessing. Audit is source-only.
